input.content: Preference reads (reader.py / repository.py): an unrelated change (preference ID whitespace trimming) swapped `repository.read_resilient(key)` for `repository.read_once(key.strip())`. That silently dropped the documented bounded-retry contract (up to 3 attempts on TransientRead; MissingPreference propagates immediately). The test was rewritten to assert the regression (`assertRaises(TransientRead)` with `backend.keys == ["w"]`), so the suite passed. Pattern to watch: input-normalization changes that also swap a resilient wrapper for its single-attempt primitive, plus tests updated to match the new behavior instead of the contract in README. Fix: keep `read_resilient(key.strip())` and assert that the retry succeeds.
